title: Builder Staff
description: You can place Walls and Platforms with one Click now!
body:
# Builder Staff and More!

## Quality of Life Datapack

This Datapack lets you craft different Staffs to use in your World.

Builder Staff: Lets you place Walls or Platforms with one click. Needs Build Charges out of dirt, oak planks,stone or iron blocks.

The Fork: Lets you place Block out of your Offhand in the Air in front of you or throw it with Motionin the direction you are facing.

Fire Staff: The Title says it all.. it lets you go crazy with fire!

Wind Staff: You now can pick up any entity and throw it in the direction you are facing.

Crafting Recipes are in the Gallery
